reviews.title: Extremely Greedy
reviews.text: It seems like this app is designed to target those looking to do better in life. It starts off by asking you questions about your life, says you can be doing more and that you need to lock in. You are then told if you want to “start your journey” you have to pay. This is a template used by countless apps that just want your money, they want you to pay before they show you what you’re paying for. Just go look up any fitness app that is Solo Leveling themed and you’ll see exactly what I’m talking about. The membership prices also fluctuate if you open and close the app which just shady in itself. It’s a shame because I think apps like this would have amazing potential if they didn’t come off as money grabs.
